localization: All from agentview hi-res back_project (step 0/14). Alphabet-soup can (blue body, silver lid, 'AL'+sunflower, behind orange juice): top ~(-0.036,-0.172,0.50). Butter box ('FARM FRESH BUTTER', standing, center): top ~(0.06,0.024,0.45). strategy_notes: Winning sequence (attempt 2, after a reset): (1) move_to (-0.036,-0.172,0.60) to pre-position over the alphabet-soup can; verified via wrist that the can sat between the fingers. (2) pi0_pick 'pick up the can' max_chunks 14 -> grasped the can (peak_lift 0.257, final gripper opening 0.0625; pi0 flagged success:false purely on the opening heuristic, but agentview confirmed the can lifted into the gripper and its table spot empty). (3) set_gripper +1 steps 5 to firm the can grip (cans are laterally weak). (4) move_to (0.02,0.23,0.72) carry at HIGH z over the basket interior. (5) move_to (0.02,0.225,0.57) descend into the basket (OSC stalls ~0.58 on floor contact). (6) release -> can in basket (term still false, needs both). (7) move_to (0.02,0.227,0.74) retreat STRAIGHT UP with NO lateral motion (critical). (8) move_to (0.06,0.024,0.60) pre-position over the butter box. (9) pi0_pick 'pick up the butter box' max_chunks 12 -> grasped (lift 0.063, gripper 0.039). (10) set_gripper +1 steps 8. (11) move_to (0.027,0.038,0.72) lift straight up. (12) move_to (0.02,0.25,0.72) carry high over the basket, offset +y from the can. (13) move_to (0.02,0.245,0.56) descend beside the can -> predicate In(butter,basket) & In(soup,basket) fired, libero_terminated=true (fired on descent, before an explicit release). KEY LEVER: pick the far-from-basket can FIRST and place the butter LAST so the final action is a place with no post-basket lateral traverse; and after every basket release, retreat STRAIGHT UP to eef z>=0.72 before any lateral move, because the open finger tips hang ~8-10cm below eef and will snag the tall basket liner at eef z<=0.62.
